What do beginners usually say about it in reviews?
Customer reviews highlight several aspects of starting out with a Cozey sofa:
What people love:
Straightforward assembly and modularity: Customers appreciate that our furniture arrives in manageable boxes and can be assembled, moved, reconfigured, or expanded over time.
Comfort options: Reviewers often praise the variety of comfort choices, from soft and cloud-like models (Ciello and Gaia) to balanced (Atmosphere) or firmer options (Cassini and Neptune).
Practical details: Many highlight the value of removable, machine-washable covers for easy maintenance.
Common challenges and feedback:
Assembly friction: While designed for easy modular setup, some customers report difficulties aligning connectors or putting on fitted covers.
Split deliveries: Because orders ship in multiple separate boxes, packages sometimes arrive on different days.
Cushion maintenance: Models with plush, loose foam-and-fiber cushions (like Ciello and Gaia) require regular fluffing every 1–2 weeks to keep their shape, which surprises some first-time owners who prefer low-maintenance seating.
If you prefer a lower-maintenance feel right out of the box, structured collections like Atmosphere or Cassini require very little fluffing compared to our softer loose-cushion styles.

Getting started is straightforward, but here are the key things to keep in mind:
No tools needed: Our sofas assemble without tools, and modules typically take about 5 to 10 minutes per seat to assemble. You can find printable instructions or step-by-step videos on our Assembly Guides page.
Space and doorways: Measure your room dimensions (width and depth, including armrests) as well as your doorways. Boxes average around 30 inches in length, width, and height, making them easy to fit through standard hallways and doors.
Online tools: You can use our online sofa configurator to test different layouts and see how overall dimensions adjust as you add or remove modules.
Free guidance: If you're unsure which setup fits your room, you can book a free online Design Consultation to go over measurements and options with our team.

What's the return policy if it turns out not to be right for me?
All Cozey items come with a 30-day risk-free trial starting from the day you receive them. If it's not the right fit for your space, you can return it free of charge, as long as you keep the original packaging.
Here are the key details to keep in mind:
Original packaging: Returns are completely free during the 30-day trial as long as items are returned in their original boxes. If any original boxes are missing, a replacement-box fee of 15% of the value of the items needing new boxes (up to a maximum of $150) is deducted from your refund.
How to start: You can initiate a return through our Self-Service Portal.
Inspection & refund: Once we receive the product, our Quality Assurance Team inspects it to ensure there are no customer-caused damages or modifications. After inspection, refunds are processed within 3 to 7 business days.
